core_meaning.primary_meaning: Adeel corresponds to Arabic عديل (ʿadīl), associated with equality/equivalence or a peer; distinguish it from عادل (ʿādil), the more direct adjective meaning just/equitable.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Adeel corresponds to the Arabic form عديل (ع د ل). Its core sense is just, fair, righteous. ʿAdīl ('just, equitable'), from the root ع د ل. Related to عادل (ʿĀdil). The source record left this name with no origin and no script form.
